name: Flood insurance claims by county and year (FEMA NFIP, OpenFEMA), 1978 to 2026
description: Every National Flood Insurance Program claim in FEMA's public NFIP claims file, counted for the nation, each state and territory and each county by the year of the loss: claims, claims with a payment and dollars paid (building, contents and increased cost of compliance), over all years since 1978, the ten full years 2016 to 2025, the latest full year and the current, partial year, with the flood event that brought the most claims since 2016 in each state. Counts and sums only; no policy, address or claimant detail is kept.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Flood insurance claims by county and year (FEMA NFIP, OpenFEMA), 1978 to 2026 (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23845801
keywords: flood claims by state and year

distribution.name: flood-claims.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: flood-claims.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: flood-claims
recordSet.description: The records of Flood insurance claims by county and year (FEMA NFIP, OpenFEMA), 1978 to 2026, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state or territory code, or US

field.name: level
field.description: us, state or county

field.name: area
field.description: US, the 2-digit state FIPS code or the 5-digit county FIPS code

field.name: areaName
field.description: County and state, state name, or United States

field.name: stateName

field.name: status
field.description: P: FEMA's own file

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Claims with a loss in the ten full years (the same as claims_10y)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: firstYear
field.description: First year of loss with a claim for this place

field.name: dataThrough

field.name: claims_total
field.description: NFIP claims, every year of loss in the file

field.name: paid_claims_total
field.description: Claims with a payment above zero

field.name: paid_usd_total
field.description: Dollars paid: building, contents and increased cost of compliance

field.name: tenYears
field.description: The ten full years of loss counted in the _10y columns

field.name: claims_10y
field.description: Claims with a loss in those ten years

field.name: paid_claims_10y
field.description: Of them, claims with a payment

field.name: paid_usd_10y
field.description: Dollars paid on them

field.name: latestYear
field.description: The latest full year of loss

field.name: claims_latest
field.description: Claims with a loss in the latest full year

field.name: paid_usd_latest
field.description: Dollars paid on them

field.name: currentYear
field.description: The current year (partial: losses to the as-of date)

field.name: claims_current

field.name: paid_usd_current
